oracleRisk.summary: sYUSD is an ERC-4626 staking receipt over YUSD whose exchange rate accrues strategy yield; it is not a borrower debt market with collateral liquidation oracles.

branchApplicability.rationale: Aegis documents sYUSD as a yield-bearing YUSD staking token with a cooldown before withdrawal. The reviewed product and smart-contract references describe receipt-token accounting and strategy yield, not borrower-specific collateral positions or oracle-triggered liquidation branches.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Both authored sYUSD deployments are local Aegis ERC-4626 wrappers over chain-local YUSD, not bridge representations. The reviewed contracts expose deposit/mint and withdrawal/cooldown share accounting but no sYUSD LayerZero/OFT, peer, endpoint, lockbox, adapter, validator/DVN, cross-chain mint/burn, or rate-limit machinery. The parent YUSD LayerZero mesh remains assessed only under yusd-aegis Bridge Risk.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex mint-bridge boundary migration; syusd-aegis finding
